scripts.test:ci: npm run test:e2e:cli && npm run integration:setup && trap 'npm run integration:stop' EXIT && npm run test:integration && npm run test:unit -- --configuration=ci && npm run test:php
scripts.db:start: cd .. && docker compose up -d backend phpmyadmin
scripts.db:provision: docker exec gaerngschee-database mariadb -uroot -prootpassword -e "CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS gaerngschee_weihnachtswuensche CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci; CREATE USER IF NOT EXISTS 'gaerngschee_weihnachtswuensche'@'%' IDENTIFIED BY 'weihnachtswuensche-local-password'; GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON gaerngschee_weihnachtswuensche.* TO 'gaerngschee_weihnachtswuensche'@'%'; FLUSH PRIVILEGES;"
scripts.db:migrate: cd .. && docker compose exec -T backend vendor/bin/phinx migrate -c /var/www/db/phinx.php
scripts.batch:orders: cd .. && docker compose exec -T backend php /var/www/html/bin/process-orders.php
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:start && sleep 5 && npm run db:provision && npm run db:migrate
scripts.db:reset: npm run db:stop && npm run db:start && sleep 5 && npm run db:migrate
scripts.integration:start: cd .. && docker compose -f docker-compose.integration.yml up -d --build --wait integration-database integration-backend
scripts.integration:migrate: cd .. && docker compose -f docker-compose.integration.yml exec -T integration-backend vendor/bin/phinx migrate -e test -c /var/www/db/phinx.php
scripts.integration:seed: cd .. && docker compose -f docker-compose.integration.yml exec -T integration-backend vendor/bin/phinx seed:run -e test -c /var/www/db/phinx.php
scripts.integration:setup: npm run integration:start && npm run integration:migrate && npm run integration:seed
scripts.composer: cd .. && docker compose exec -T backend composer install --no-interaction
scripts.composer:update: cd .. && docker compose exec -T backend composer update --no-interaction
